Name: Shimei, Son of Zacchur
Summary: Son of Zacchur in Simeon's line, who had sixteen sons and six daughters.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:26: Son of Zacchur in Simeon's line, who had sixteen sons and six daughters.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shimei stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
